relevant_laws.quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn where both intersecting highways are one-way, both the approach for the left turn and the left turn must be made as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge of the highway.
relevant_laws.notes: The selected cell is a one-way to one-way left-turn intersection; source inspection is still required.
